lines.text: Many learners say: The woman which lives next door is nice.
Better: The woman who lives next door is nice.
For a person, we say who.
Who! The man who works here.

data.wrong: The woman which lives next door is nice.
data.right: The woman who lives next door is nice.
data.why: For a person, we say who.

quiz.stem: The man ___ works here is nice.
